images.description:
List of image files, photos or floor plans related to the listing.
Supported image file formats: AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIF/HEIC, JPEG, JPEG 2000, PNG, TIFF, WebP.
The file size is restricted to maximum 100MB.
We recommend against using transparent backgrounds.
Some image formats, such as PNG, support transparency, but when images with transparent areas are resized, they may be converted to a format that doesn’t support transparency, such as JPEG.
By default, transparent areas are converted to black, but the application displaying the image may convert the transparent area to the most appropriate colour for the area where the image is being placed.

supplementary.description:
Rural attributes

*Improvements* (optional)

Available `types` (fixed list, optional):
* Machinery Shed
* Shearing Shed
* Workshop
* Shearers Quarters
* Silos
* Other Housing
* Managers Accommodation

*Fencing* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): free text fencing description, maximum 250 characters.

*Yards* (optional)

Available `types` (fixed list, optional):
* Sheep
* Cattle

*Homestead* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): description of the homestead and construction, maximum 250 characters.

`metadata` (optional)
* `area` (decimal, optional): homestead area in square metres.

Available `types` (fixed list, optional):
* Office
* Ensuite
* Tennis Court
* Mains Gas
* Floorboards
* Internal Laundry

*Water* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): water comments, maximum 250 characters.

Available `types` (fixed list, optional):
* Tank
* Well
* Reticulated
* Bores
* Springs
* Creeks
* Dams
* River

*Crops* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): description of the crops, maximum 250 characters.

`metadata` (optional)
* `croppedAnnually` (decimal, optional): average annual area cropped in hectares.
* `fallowAnnually` (decimal, optional): average annual fallow area in hectares.
* `pastures` (string, optional): description of pastures available, maximum 250 characters.

*Livestock* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): additional comments, maximum 250 characters.

`metadata` (optional)
* `capacity` (decimal, optional): property carrying capacity in DSE (unit of carry capacity).

Available `types` (fixed list, optional):
* Sheep
* Pigs
* Cattle
* Poultry
* Horses
* Exotic
* Goats
* Stud

*Inclusions* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): description of plant and machinery included in sale, maximum 250 characters.

`metadata` (optional)
* `livestock` (string, optional): description of livestock included in sale, maximum 250 characters.
* `crop` (string, optional): description of crops included in sale, maximum 250 characters.

*Irrigation* (optional)

`description` (string, optional): irrigation comments, maximum 250 characters

`metadata` (optional)
* `rainfall` (decimal, optional): annual rainfall in millimetres.

pastInspections.description: Inspection details for the property. e.g. opening and closing times

isByAppointmentOnly.description: True or False indicating whether the inspection is by appointment only

url.description: The URL to the property media

Listings.V2.ListingMedia.description: Encapsulates media associated with a Listing

priceFrom.description: Price starting range of the property

priceTo.description: Upper price range of the property

canDisplayPrice.description: Flag indicating whether the advertiser has chosen to display the property price

items.description: Reason for price hidden  * `ByAgency` - Agency doesn't want to show prcie * `QLDRestriction` - Price can not be shown due to QLD restrictions

hiddenReasons.description: Reasons when price need to be hidden

displayPrice.description: A string provided by the Advertiser representing the ByIdListingPriceQueryResult of the Listing e.g. Over $1,000,000   This should be the default price field for client to use

priceReduction.description: Indicates if this property is under price reduction

Listings.V2.ProviderDetails.description: Information for the listing provider. e.g. bulkuploader information

leasedDate.description: The Date the listing was leased. DateTime is in a local timezone.

leasedPrice.description: The last leased price entered by the Advertiser  This price will only be visible if allowed by the Advertiser  and the listing as been leased

canDisplayPrice.description: Indicates whether this instance can display price

leasedMonths.description: The number of months the property was last leased for  This will only be visible if the property has been leased

Listings.V2.RentalDetails.description: The rental detail's of the listing in case of it being for rent or leased

soldPrice.description: The last sold price entered by the Advertiser.  This price will only be visible if allowed by the Advertiser  and the listing as been sold

governmentRecordedSoldPrice.description: The government recorded sold price sourced from APM

soldDate.description: The Date the listing was sold. DateTime is in a local timezone.

canDisplayPrice.description: Indicates whether this instance can display price

Listings.V2.SoldDetails.description: Sold details in the case of the listing being sold.

locationDescription.description: Description and location of the auction provided by advertiser

openingDateTime.description: Opening date and time of the auction. e.g. 2015-01-01T12:00:00  DateTime is in a local timezone.

Listings.V2.AuctionSchedule.description: Encapsulates the details of a Property being Auctioned.

auctionedPrice.description: The auctioned price entered by the Advertiser.  This price will only be visible if allowed by the Advertiser  and the listing as been auctioned

auctionedDate.description: The listing's last auctioned date and time specified by the Advertiser.  This will only be visible if the listing has been auctioned.  DateTime is in a local timezone.

Listings.V2.AuctionDetails.description: The detail's of the auction in case of a listing for sale being auctioned or sold by auction

tenderEndDate.description: Tender closing date. DateTime is in a local timezone.

leaseOptions.description: Leasing options available to a prospective tenant

tenantInfoTermOfLeaseFrom.description: The from range of the tenant's current lease

tenantInfoTermOfLeaseTo.description: The to range of the tenant's current lease

tenantName.description: Name of the current tenant of the property

leaseStartDate.description: The date on which the tenants lease began, or is due to begin. DateTime is in a local timezone.

leaseEndDate.description: The date on which the tenants lease is due to end. DateTime is in a local timezone.

annualReturn.description: Integer value of percentage return on this property or business

saleTerms.description: Information relating to aspects of the sale, such as required deposit, settlement time

Listings.V2.SaleDetails.description: The sale detail's of the listing in case of it being for sale or sold

from.description: Lowest price the property is expected to sell/rent for to set search price.

to.description: Highest price the property is expected to sell/rent for to set search price.

comparableProperty.description: Comparable properties that are of a similar standard or condition to the property for sale

declarationText.description: Text description if there are less than three comparable sales available

Listings.V2.ComparableData.description: Information regarding the past comparable property sales that influenced the setting of the estimation price

suburb.description: Name of the suburb median price is based on.

source.description: Where median price data comes from

sourceDateFrom.description: Start date of the median price source time period

sourceDateTo.description: End date of the median price source time period

sourceCollectionDate.description: The collection date of the median price source

Listings.V2.MedianPriceData.description: Information regarding median house/unit price   for the suburb

documentationUrl.description: Link to the statement of information documentation file

Listings.V2.StatementOfInformation.description: Statement of Information  Regarding sale listing

id.description: The identifier which uniquely identifies the listing.

bathrooms.description: Total number of bathrooms in the property

bedrooms.description: Total number of bedrooms in the property; Studio apartments have a value of \"0\"

buildingArea.description: The building area display value of the property e.g. 160 ha

buildingAreaSqm.description: The properties building area in square meters

carspaces.description: Total number of car spaces in the property.

dateAvailable.description: The date the property is available. DateTime is in a local timezone.

dateCreated.description: The date/time the listing was created. DateTime is in AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time) or AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time) timezone.

dateUpdated.description: The date/time the listing had major update. DateTime is in AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time) or AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time) timezone.

dateMinorUpdated.description: When minor update applied to the listing. DateTime is in AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time) or AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time) timezone.

datePurged.description: The date/time the listing was purged. It's only returned for archived listings. DateTime is in AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time) or AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time) timezone.

dateListed.description: The date/time last listed. DateTime is in AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time) or AEDT (Australian Eastern Daylight Time) timezone.

description.description: The long description of the property provided by the advertiser.

devProjectId.description: The ID of the development project - null if no associated project

energyEfficiencyRating.description: Energy Efficiency Rating value for ACT properties

features.description: The property features specified by the advertiser

headline.description: The short description of the property provided by the advertiser.

isNewDevelopment.description: Indicates whether the property is a new development

landArea.description: The land area display string for the property e.g. 160 sqm

landAreaSqm.description: The properties land area in square meters

media.description: The media associated with the property provided by the advertiser

propertyId.description: The identifier which uniquely identifies the property being advertised.  This may be empty if the Address of property is poorly described

isWithdrawn.description: Indicates if the property has been withdrawn from the market  The value will be 'true' When a listing is taken off market without being sold or leased.

homepassEnabled.description: If Homepass is enabled for the listing (agency)

numberOfDwellings.description: Number of dwellings for current listing

eventdate.description: date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

propertyId.description: Property ID of property to use as the center of the search radius.

radius.description: Radius of the search in KM. Default is 5km.

startDate.description: Start date for filtering based on the date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Valid only for search type 'sold'.

endDate.description: End date for filtering based on the date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Valid only for search type 'sold'.

landSizeMin.description: Minimum land size in square meters.

landSizeMax.description: Maximum land size in square meters.

gnafId.description: Gnaf ID of property to use as the center of the search radius.

latitude.description: latitude of the coordinates to use as the center of the search radius.

longitude.description: longitude of the coordinates to use as the center of the search radius.

price.description: Final sale price of the property

yearRange.description: The range of year levels offered by the school.

icsea.description: The Index of Community Socio-Educational Advantage score for the school. This score is derived from a number of variables including parental school and non-school education and occupation, the school’s geographical location and proportion of Indigenous students.

bottomSeaQuarter.description: The percentage of students positioned in the lowest socio-educational advantage quarter.

lowerMiddleSeaQuarter.description: The percentage of students positioned in the lower middle socio-educational advantage quarter.

upperMiddleSeaQuarter.description: The percentage of students positioned in the higher middle socio-educational advantage quarter.

topSeaQuarter.description: The percentage of students positioned in the highest socio-educational advantage quarter.

totalEnrolments.description: The total number of students, including both full-time and part-time students, who are enrolled at the school in the calendar year specified.

girlsEnrolments.description: The total number of female students, including both full-time and part-time students, who are enrolled at the school in the calendar year specified.

boysEnrolments.description: The total number of male students, including full-time and part-time students, who are enrolled at the school in the calendar year specified.
